packageRules.description: Label CUPS bumps so they get their own section in the release notes (.github/release.yml).
Stay on libcupsfilters 2.1.x: upstream marks 2.2.0/2.2.1 as regressed by the QPDF->PDFio transition and recommends 2.1.x. Lift once a fixed 2.2.x ships.
Group GitHub Actions bumps into one PR labelled ci; they never change the image.
